stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its application in large language model tasks.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the broader AI/ML ecosystem (transformers, llama).

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: For the first time, the US military confirms it has deployed weapons in orbit
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: The US military has officially confirmed the deployment of space-based weapons.
These new assets are designed to provide defensive capabilities for the joint military force.
This marks a significant escalation in the militarization and control of orbital space.

stories.title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces 'plan injection,' a novel adversarial attack against Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring systems.
The attack involves injecting seemingly benign but harmful reasoning into an LLM's context to steer it toward unsafe actions.
This research highlights a critical vulnerability in current LLM safety mechanisms that rely on external monitoring.

stories.title: K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations
stories.author: Elena Volkova
bullet_points: Introduces K-Bench, a new benchmark specifically designed to test LLMs in high-risk mental health scenarios.
The benchmark is clinically calibrated and evaluates 125 model configurations from 14 different providers.
It covers critical topics including suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, and substance misuse, addressing major safety concerns in LLM deployment.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML frameworks like transformers and safetensors, indicating a focus on practical model deployment.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B parameter open model, is now accessible via Ollama.
The model is specifically designed for autonomous agents capable of multi-step tasks and tool-calling.
It is optimized to run locally on user hardware, emphasizing on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured $88 million in funding from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
The company currently serves a substantial user base of 8.9 million developers.
The funding round signals growing industry confidence in open-source model serving platforms.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31.
The performance boost is achieved on Apple Silicon using MLX and multi-token prediction (MTP).
Coding agent performance shows up to 90% speedup based on the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using its MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses and faster inference times.
The updated engine also demonstrates better memory efficiency when running models on Apple Silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these personal AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Meta is launching 'Meta One' subscription bundles to monetize its ecosystem.
These bundles integrate standalone app subscriptions with enhanced AI usage capabilities, notably tied to Muse.
The tiered structure targets individual users, creators, and businesses, signaling a strategic shift toward AI monetization.

stories.title: Exclusive: Paying for frontier AI models buys 4-month head start at 5x the cost
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Open-source AI models are rapidly closing the capability gap with proprietary, frontier models.
The cost difference is significant, with paying for frontier models costing up to five times more.
The report suggests that paying for premium AI offers a substantial, measurable advantage (a 4-month head start).

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Proposes a novel method to enable skill routing within a frozen Large Language Model (LLM) without relying on external context or retrieval pipelines.
Argues that the necessary routing signal is inherently present within the LLM's own forward passes, rather than needing external mechanisms.
Demonstrates that only two linear maps are sufficient to effectively read and utilize this native routing signal.

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: The research proposes a novel method to enable LLM agents to select appropriate 'skills' without relying on external context loading or complex retrieval pipelines.
The core finding is that the routing signal for skill selection is inherently present within the frozen LLM's own forward passes.
The authors demonstrate that simple linear maps are sufficient to extract this native routing capability from the LLM.

stories.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Addresses the 'supervision gap' in training advanced LLMs by focusing on human-aware interaction.
Proposes 'Mind2Dialogue' to train models by simulating users' unspoken beliefs and goals.
Highlights the necessity of understanding user mental states for effective long-term AI collaboration.

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Proposes a novel method to achieve native skill routing within a frozen Large Language Model (LLM) without relying on external context management.
Challenges existing routing mechanisms (like context preloading or retrieval pipelines) which suffer from attention dispersion or loss of agent capability.
Demonstrates that the routing signal can be extracted directly from the LLM's internal forward passes using simple linear maps.

stories.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
stories.author: Yingcheng Wu
bullet_points: Proposes 'Discovery Intelligence' as the next major frontier for Foundation Models.
DFMs aim to move beyond solving human-specified problems to actively creating new problems, knowledge, and representations.
The evolution involves a shift from learning/reasoning over existing data to learning through action and outcome feedback.

stories.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Addresses the 'supervision gap' in training advanced LLMs by focusing on user mental states.
Proposes 'Mind2Dialogue' to train human-aware language models capable of deeper collaboration.
Highlights the necessity of understanding users' unspoken beliefs and goals for next-generation AI assistants.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
stories.author: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy
bullet_points: SimpliSafe is launching a new AI-powered Video Doorbell Series 2.
The system integrates AI analysis with live human security agents for proactive threat detection.
The doorbell is priced at $199.99, requiring a subscription to the Active Guard service.

stories.title: GM updates its trucks’ native software to coexist with CarPlay
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: GM is enhancing the native software experience in its trucks to improve usability and reduce driver distraction.
The update introduces new picture-in-picture displays for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.
This move signals a shift away from GM's previous resistance to phone mirroring integration.

stories.title: Microsoft issues emergency Windows 11 update to fix its record-breaking patch
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Microsoft released an emergency out-of-band update for Windows 11.
The update addresses bugs introduced in the massive September Patch Tuesday release.
The initial patch contained nearly 1,000 fixes but caused issues affecting businesses and developers, specifically related to Hyper-V folder shares.

stories.title: Volvo increases the batteries for 2028 XC60 and XC90 plug-in refresh
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Volvo is upgrading the battery capacity for the 2028 refresh of the XC60 and XC90 plug-in models.
The refreshed vehicles will feature new infotainment systems.
The new infotainment systems will incorporate Google's Gemini AI.

stories.title: Rocket Lab is seeing red about NASA's decision on a Mars spacecraft
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Rocket Lab is publicly criticizing NASA's recent award decision regarding a Mars spacecraft.
The core of Rocket Lab's complaint is that the decision seems to contradict the established eligibility criteria.
This highlights potential friction or disputes within the space industry regarding government contract allocation.

stories.title: AI bots "Timmy," "Ren," and "Jackie" are flooding social media with slop
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: AI bots are proliferating rapidly across social media platforms.
These bots are generating low-quality, repetitive content ('slop').
The phenomenon highlights the current challenges of AI content moderation and quality control.

stories.title: OpenAI stuck fighting Musk antitrust suit after Apple finds a way out
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: OpenAI is facing ongoing antitrust challenges, despite recent developments.
Elon Musk has paused his legal actions against Apple concerning ChatGPT integration.
The situation highlights the complex regulatory and competitive landscape surrounding major AI players.

stories.title: Founder’s cost-cutting obsession drove Unitree lead in cheap humanoid robots
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Unitree's success in developing affordable humanoid robots is attributed to the founder's intense cost-cutting focus.
The article questions the scalability of the founder's highly micromanaging leadership style.
The story touches upon the intersection of robotics manufacturing, cost optimization, and leadership effectiveness.

stories.title: Apple releases iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate 27 with Siri AI and Liquid Glass refinements
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Apple released iOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate 27, featuring updates to Siri AI and Liquid Glass.
The release marks the final version of macOS to maintain support for Rosetta for Intel applications.
The update focuses on AI integration within Siri and refinements to the user interface.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of current language models in handling long-horizon, complex research problems in math and theoretical CS.
Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a model-agnostic harness designed to manage and explore diverse inference strategies for these difficult tasks.
Features mechanisms like a 'readiness gate' to intelligently decide when a research path is mature enough for decomposition.

stories.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale
stories.author: Amin Karbasi
bullet_points: Introduces the Vulnerability Localization Benchmark (VLoc Bench) to address a gap in current AI security evaluations.
Focuses on 'vulnerability localization'—identifying the specific code files related to a weakness within a large repository.
Highlights the growing trend of language-model agents operating over entire software repositories, necessitating better localization tools.

stories.title: SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection
stories.author: Tao Yu
bullet_points: SlipSense introduces a multimodal tactile learning framework for improved slip detection in dexterous manipulation.
The system integrates a high-frequency piezoresistive array ($32 	imes 32$ at 240 Hz) with a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer (8 kHz).
The research addresses key limitations in existing systems: precise latency characterization and cross-platform generalization.

stories.title: Privacy-enhanced federated learning via asynchronous aggregation and local differential perturbation
stories.author: Liesheng Wei
bullet_points: Proposes a privacy-enhanced federated learning framework for secure collaborative training.
Integrates Dynamic Differential Privacy (DDP), Homomorphic Encryption (HE), and Local Differential Privacy (LDP) for data protection.
Utilizes an asynchronous aggregation strategy with version control to handle distributed training environments.

stories.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
stories.author: Lidong Bing
bullet_points: Introduces Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free reinforcement learning method.
BPO is designed to improve the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) using verifiable rewards (RLVR).
It reformulates Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) for autoregressive generation by using Bellman equations to create a trajectory-level objective.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of current language models in handling long-horizon, complex research problems in math and TCS.
Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a model-agnostic harness designed to manage and explore multiple inference strategies for these problems.
Features mechanisms like a 'readiness gate' to strategically decompose research paths based on maturity.

stories.title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
stories.author: Ziming Liu
bullet_points: The research addresses a fundamental issue in video generation models: distinguishing between a failure to learn correct motion versus a failure to utilize learned motion.
The authors demonstrate that correct motion information can remain latent within the model even when the output is physically incorrect.
They propose a method (Causal Writability) allowing low-dimensional edits to override generated motion, even when conflicting training data is present.

stories.title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
stories.author: Shen Yan
bullet_points: The research analyzes how Transformer representations evolve using a functional geometry approach.
It decomposes learned updates into parallel and perpendicular components relative to the current direction.
Findings reveal significant parallel components in updates beyond the standard residual identity path, applied to attention and MLP layers.

stories.title: Privacy-Aligned Personalized Federated Learning with Compact Adaptation and Variable-Length Gaussian Communication
stories.author: Linqi Song
bullet_points: Addresses a structural misalignment in personalized federated learning when client variation is low-dimensional but updates are high-dimensional.
Proposes a solution by releasing a private client context only once and restricting repeated adaptation to a fixed coefficient space.
Introduces a factorized generator to induce an adaptive optimization geometry that reshapes noisy updates for better privacy alignment.

stories.title: Safe Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Information Space Reachability
stories.author: Navid Azizan
bullet_points: Addresses a critical gap in Meta-Reinforcement Learning (Meta-RL): ensuring safety during adaptation to new tasks.
Proposes a novel safe Meta-RL framework that explicitly incorporates safety constraints into the learning process.
The core technical contribution involves reasoning about safety within the 'information space,' which integrates physical state and agent belief.

stories.title: SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection
stories.author: Tao Yu
bullet_points: Introduces SlipSense, a multimodal framework for low-latency and generalized slip detection in dexterous manipulation.
Utilizes a compact sensor (TacV5) combining a $32 	imes 32$ piezoresistive array (240 Hz) and a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer (8 kHz).
Addresses limitations in current systems regarding detection latency and cross-platform generalization for tactile sensing.

stories.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
stories.author: Lidong Bing
bullet_points: Introduces Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free reinforcement learning method.
BPO is designed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) using verifiable rewards (RLVR).
The method reformulates Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) for autoregressive generation using Bellman equations, avoiding intermediate state value estimation.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a new model-agnostic harness designed to manage long-horizon research problems.
Addresses the current limitation of LLMs in producing reliable, long-sequence proofs in fields like mathematics and theoretical computer science.
The harness explores alternative strategies and uses a 'readiness gate' to guide the decomposition of complex research tasks.

stories.title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
stories.author: Shen Yan
bullet_points: The research models Transformer representation evolution as a functional geometry, decomposing updates into parallel and perpendicular components.
The study reveals significant parallel components in learned updates beyond the standard residual identity path across pretrained models.
The decomposition method is applied to analyze updates within both attention mechanisms and MLP layers relative to the hidden state.

stories.title: Verifiable by Construction: Claim-Level Evaluation of Verbatim Citation in Clinical Question Answering
stories.author: Michael Oberst
bullet_points: Addresses a critical limitation in current LLM-based clinical QA: citations are often too broad for efficient verification.
Proposes a novel approach where answers are 'verifiable by construction' by providing fine-grained, verbatim quotes.
Aims to significantly improve the trustworthiness and usability of LLMs in high-stakes medical environments for time-pressed clinicians.

stories.title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'HypoEvolve,' a framework using genetic algorithms to enable multi-agent LLMs in scientific hypothesis discovery.
The system allows scientific agents to synthesize evidence, assess proposals, and generate new explanations through evolutionary search.
The research aims to decouple the impact of agents' scientific capabilities from the effects of their collaboration on hypothesis quality.

stories.title: Inoculation Midtraining with Learned Neologisms
stories.author: David Demitri Africa
bullet_points: Introduces 'Inoculation Midtraining,' a technique to shape LLM behavior during earlier training stages.
The method uses a designated `<quarantine_token>` neologism to teach models to associate unsafe behavior with a specific context.
Aims to control which properties (desirable vs. undesirable) an LLM generalizes during post-training.

stories.title: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite
stories.author: bashtian
bullet_points: Capsule is a new tool allowing the bundling of HTML web applications and their data into a single SQLite file.
It is built using Rust and Tauri 2.0, suggesting a focus on lightweight, local desktop applications.
The core innovation addresses the difficulty of persisting and sharing data for simple, single-file web apps.
